ingredients.name: Granny Smith apples, peeled, cored and sliced

steps.instruction: Put 4 sliced sweet potatoes in a greased 2-quart baking dish.
Add 4 sliced Granny Smith apples and 1/2 cup of raisins.
Mix 2 tablespoons of honey, 3 tablespoons of apple juice or cider and the butter.
steps.spoken: Mix 2 tablespoons of honey, 3 tablespoons of apple juice or cider and 3 tablespoons of melted butter.

steps.instruction: Pour the mixture over the dish.
Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover with foil and bake at 350 °F for 30 to 45 minutes, until the sweet potatoes are tender and glazed.
